meta.title: 萨拉曼卡Vlog｜漫游西班牙02
meta.topic: 旅行Vlog · 西班牙 · 萨拉曼卡

scenes.title_en: Opening: A Ghost Town We Passed
scenes.context: 博主前往萨拉曼卡途中路过一座完全没人的小城，感到有些吓人；到达后看到酒店大堂觉得房间会很不错。语域：旅行记录。
sentences: 我们路过了一座小城，完全是空城，整个城一个人都没有，好吓人。
We passed a small town that was completely empty — not a single person, kind of creepy.
completely empty（完全是空城）；kind of creepy（有点吓人）
光是看到酒店大堂，我就感觉房间会很不错。
Just seeing the hotel lobby, I could already tell the room would be nice.
could already tell（就能感觉到）
我妈妈正在办理入住。
My mom is checking in right now.
check in（办理入住）
paraphrase: 完全没人 → completely empty / totally deserted
completely empty · totally deserted
有点吓人 → kind of creepy / a little eerie
kind of creepy · a little eerie
scenes.speak: We passed a small town that was completely empty — not a single person, kind of creepy. Just seeing the hotel lobby, I could already tell the room would be nice. My mom is checking in right now.

scenes.title_cn: 欧洲特色：直载电梯与0楼
scenes.title_en: European Quirks: The Cage Elevator & Floor Zero
scenes.context: 博主吐槽欧洲特色：透明直载的老式电梯，以及「一楼」其实是0楼（西班牙语 planta baja）。语域：吐槽+文化观察。
sentences: 还有一个欧洲特色，如此直载的电梯。
And another European quirk — this super basic, see-through elevator.
a European quirk（欧洲特色）；see-through elevator（透明电梯）
我们刚刚在零楼，我们要去一楼。
We're on floor zero, and we need to go to the first floor.
floor zero（零楼）；the first floor（一楼）
让我们一起期待一下房间的景色。
Let's look forward to the view from the room together.
look forward to（期待）；the view from the room（房间景色）
paraphrase: 欧洲特色 → a European quirk / a European thing
European quirk
期待 → look forward to / can't wait to see
look forward to · can't wait
scenes.speak: And another European quirk — this super basic, see-through elevator. We're on floor zero, and we need to go to the first floor. Let's look forward to the view from the room together.

scenes.title_cn: 2000年前的桥：从新世纪走向老城
scenes.title_en: A 2,000-Year-Old Bridge: From New to Ancient
scenes.context: 博主介绍古罗马桥：一半是2000年前的，另一半是16世纪洪水冲塌后新建的；走过桥就像从新的世纪走向2000年前的老城。语域：历史+比喻。
sentences: 又是一座罗马人留下的遗迹，但是不是整座桥都是2000年前的。
Another Roman relic — but not the whole bridge is two thousand years old.
a Roman relic（罗马遗迹）；not the whole ... is（不全是…）
之前洪水冲塌过一次，离咱们近的这一半是16世纪左右新建的。
It collapsed once in a flood — the half near us was rebuilt around the sixteenth century.
collapse in a flood（被洪水冲塌）；rebuilt around the sixteenth century（16世纪左右重建）
咱们走这个桥，也跟走那个时间长廊一样，从新的世纪走向2000年前的老城。
Crossing this bridge is like walking through a time corridor — from the new century into a two-thousand-year-old city.
a time corridor（时间长廊）；from the new into the ancient（从新走向古）
paraphrase: 不全是 → not the whole ... is / only part of it is
not the whole · only part of
时间长廊 → a time corridor / a walk through time
time corridor · walk through time
scenes.speak: Another Roman relic — but not the whole bridge is two thousand years old. It collapsed once in a flood — the half near us was rebuilt around the sixteenth century. Crossing this bridge is like walking through a time corridor — from the new century into a two-thousand-year-old city.

scenes.title_cn: 双座大教堂：舍不得拆旧的
scenes.title_en: The Twin Cathedrals: Too Fond to Demolish
scenes.context: 博主介绍萨拉曼卡罕见的双座大教堂：别的地方建新教堂会把旧的拆掉，这里舍不得拆，于是新旧两座连在一起。语域：历史讲解。
sentences: 这里是全世界都非常罕见的两个教堂连在一起。
This is a rare sight around the world — two cathedrals joined together.
a rare sight（罕见的景观）；joined together（连在一起）
像昨天看到的塞戈维亚，他们的教堂就是把新的建了以后就把旧的给拆了。
Like the cathedral we saw in Segovia yesterday — they built the new one and tore down the old one.
tear down the old one（拆掉旧的）
但是这里他们没有舍得拆旧的，最后就变成了两座教堂连在一起。
But here they couldn't bear to tear down the old one, so the two cathedrals ended up joined together.
couldn't bear to tear down（舍不得拆）
paraphrase: 罕见的 → a rare sight / very uncommon / hardly seen elsewhere
a rare sight · hardly seen
舍不得拆 → couldn't bear to tear down / too attached to demolish
couldn't bear · too attached
scenes.speak: This is a rare sight around the world — two cathedrals joined together. Like the cathedral we saw in Segovia yesterday — they built the new one and tore down the old one. But here they couldn't bear to tear down the old one, so the two cathedrals ended up joined together.

scenes.title_cn: 萨拉曼卡大学：找青蛙不挂科
scenes.title_en: Salamanca University: Find the Frog, Pass the Year
scenes.context: 博主介绍世界上最古老的大学之一萨拉曼卡大学：据说找到墙上的青蛙这学期就不用挂科；中世纪大学有豁免权，学生犯法警察不能抓。语域：趣闻+历史。
sentences: 欢迎来到世界上最古老的大学之一，萨拉曼卡大学。
Welcome to one of the oldest universities in the world — the University of Salamanca.
one of the oldest universities（最古老的大学之一）
你试试看你可以找到青蛙吗，据说如果你能找到墙上的青蛙的话，这学期就不用挂科了。
See if you can find the frog — legend says if you find the frog on the wall, you won't fail any class this semester.
won't fail any class（不挂科）；legend says（据说）
在中世纪神权至上的时代，大学有非常高贵的豁免权，学生犯法警察是不可以来抓你的。
In the Middle Ages, when religion reigned supreme, the university had noble privileges — the police couldn't arrest students for crimes.
reign supreme（至上）；noble privileges（高贵的豁免权）
paraphrase: 不用挂科 → won't fail any class / you'll pass the semester
won't fail · pass the semester
豁免权 → noble privileges / immunity
noble privileges · immunity
scenes.speak: Welcome to one of the oldest universities in the world — the University of Salamanca. See if you can find the frog — legend says if you find the frog on the wall, you won't fail any class this semester. In the Middle Ages, when religion reigned supreme, the university had noble privileges — the police couldn't arrest students for crimes.

scenes.title_cn: 贝壳之家：炫耀对妻子的爱
scenes.title_en: The House of Shells: Showing Off Love
scenes.context: 博主介绍贝壳之家：男主人把家族的扇贝徽章和妻子家族的何欢花融合，造了满墙贝壳来炫耀对妻子的爱。语域：趣闻讲述。
sentences: 我最喜欢的一种说法是，男主人他们家族的徽章是扇贝，他妻子的家族是百合花。
My favorite story is that the owner's family crest was a scallop shell, and his wife's family emblem was a lily.
family crest（家族徽章）；scallop shell（扇贝）
然后他就把他们融合在一起，然后就炫耀他对妻子的爱。
So he merged the two and showed off his love for his wife.
merge the two（把两者融合）；show off his love（炫耀他的爱）
就搞了这么这么多。
And that's how all these shells came to be.
and that's how（就这样）；all these shells（满墙贝壳）
paraphrase: 家族徽章 → family crest / coat of arms
family crest · coat of arms
炫耀 → show off / flaunt
show off · flaunt
scenes.speak: My favorite story is that the owner's family crest was a scallop shell, and his wife's family emblem was a lily. So he merged the two and showed off his love for his wife. And that's how all these shells came to be.

scenes.context: 博主提到萨拉曼卡因当地红砂石建筑在阳光下泛金，别名「黄金之城」；随后离开这座有文化气质的城市，前往葡萄牙。语域：收尾道别。
sentences: 这周围的建筑物都是当地产的红砂石建的，所以萨拉曼卡还有一个名字叫做黄金之城。
The buildings around here are all made of local red sandstone, which is why Salamanca is also called the Golden City.
red sandstone（红砂石）；be also called（还有一个名字叫做）
我们要离开这个非常有文化气质的城市了。
It's time to leave this city full of cultural character.
full of cultural character（有文化气质）
接下来的几天，西班牙都是四十几度的高温。
For the next few days, Spain will be over forty degrees.
over forty degrees（40多度）；高温天气表达
paraphrase: 黄金之城 → the Golden City / known as the Golden City
Golden City · known as
文化气质 → cultural character / cultural atmosphere
cultural character · atmosphere
scenes.speak: The buildings around here are all made of local red sandstone, which is why Salamanca is also called the Golden City. It's time to leave this city full of cultural character. For the next few days, Spain will be over forty degrees.

practice: This old see-through elevator is such a European thing.
Half the bridge is two thousand years old; the other half was rebuilt in the sixteenth century.
Find the frog on the wall, and you won't fail any class this semester.
The owner merged his scallop crest with his wife's lily emblem to show his love.
pitfalls: Half the bridge dates back two thousand years; the other half is sixteenth century.
只说不全是2000年，分开说明两半年代才准确。
I will not fail my class.
You won't fail any class this semester.
这是传说/习俗，用 legend says + 将来时更有叙述感；fail any class 比 my class 准确。
It's one of the oldest universities in the world.
具体到 one of the oldest in the world 更有信息量。
The police couldn't arrest students for crimes in the Middle Ages.
补充时间状语 in the Middle Ages 使历史陈述更严谨。
shifts: 用 ancient（古老）、a Roman relic（罗马遗迹）、dates back to（追溯到）、original site（原址）
用 rare sight（罕见景观）、golden（金色）、picturesque（如画）
用 one of the oldest、student privileges、semester、campus
